text: Evidence for the property-law half of this acceptance criterion. A 2026-08-03 exhaustive audit compared every hand-written encoder and decoder in AgentDomainJson.scala, StructuredResultCodec.scala, AgentMessageCodec.scala, ControlCommandJson.scala and FileJournalControlStore.JournalCodec against the fields of the type each one serializes. Exactly one field was silently dropped: JobObservation.reportedCluster, fixed as P8.A7. Every other hand-written codec covers its full field set. The relevant finding is WHY the one instance was invisible: reportedCluster has a default value, so the decoder could construct JobObservation with eight of nine arguments and still typecheck under -Werror, and no fixture or property pinned the field set. The audit was a one-time snapshot and cannot prevent recurrence; a round-trip law over generated values is the only check that fails automatically when the next defaulted field is added. That is the specific regression this bead should close, and it applies to any type whose codec is hand-written and whose fields have defaults.
